title: Stadium LED animation, lamp glow and facade passes verified on host
summary: Restored the source stadium facade pass and additive lamp material while preserving original geometry, and verified the ten-frame LED clock and lifecycle on desktop and portrait.
details: The original stadium lamp uses the source GS equation (Cs-0)*As+Cd, represented by SRC_ALPHA/ONE; the authored renderer retains its lamp mesh and texture. The building08sky14 reflection and diffuse facade passes render in source order over identical geometry with LEQUAL; reflection changes UVs, not vertex positions.

Original compressed ATM screens in SX05–SX11 and SX14 decode ten frames with four mip levels each, begin at frame zero and loop forward at 10 fps. Pause/resume, placement reset and WebGL context restoration preserve the venue animation clock. The inspected portrait host capture shows the repaired facade; automated camera and legacy-material probes are test-only.

All40 host driving routes passed with no scenery texture decode errors. Reflection transform feedback matched 2,304 Rust comparisons across three model/node configurations with maximum UV error 7.152557373046875e-7. Host ATV1 desktop/portrait lamp contributions were 3,156/4,193 pixels and facade contributions 123,475/192,926 pixels; motorcycle27 desktop/portrait contributions were 7,940/9,969 lamp pixels and 222,801/316,455 facade pixels. Pixel counts vary with viewport and capture timing; lifecycle runs reported no page or GL errors.

A separate frozen host WebKit override over public assets passed its initial-frame, ten-frame, pause/reset and context-restoration checks. It remains a private candidate override, not the deployed renderer.
limitation: This is host-only component evidence, not a public release, physical-phone capture, complete original GS/VU pixel parity, crowd animation recovery or live stadium-screen video. Camera/material overrides and frozen worker replay are test-only; production behavior and the complete draw schedule remain bounded.
caption: Host Chromium portrait capture (390×844): source stadium facade and surrounding scenery after restoring the ordered reflection and diffuse passes. The camera and material inspection setup are test-only; this is not a physical-phone capture.
